text: Add a loading spinner to the profile save button while the request is pending.
Create a GET route that returns the application's health status as JSON.
Add an empty-state message when the notifications list has no items.
Expose the server port through an environment variable with a default value.
Add a required email field to the account settings form.
Return HTTP 204 after a successful deletion in this controller.
Add a database index for the orders.created_at column.
Display the current user's avatar in the navigation bar.
Add a route alias for the existing password-reset page.
Include the request ID in the structured response headers.
Add a placeholder option to the country select control.
Create a migration that adds a nullable last_seen_at timestamp to users.
Render a 404 page when a requested blog post cannot be found.
Add a maximum length attribute to the product title input.
Return the newly created comment in the POST response body.
Add a unique constraint to the workspace slug column.
Show the API version in the footer of the admin dashboard.
Add a CORS allowlist entry for the local frontend origin.
Create a reusable badge component for displaying order status.

Make the sidebar collapse when the mobile menu close icon is clicked.
Add a route parameter for the invoice ID to this endpoint definition.
Set the default page size for the audit-log query to 25.
Add an aria-label to the icon-only search button.
Include a createdAt field in the GraphQL Task type.
Create a database seed record for the default administrator role.
Hide the beta navigation item unless the feature flag is enabled.
Add a response content-type header for CSV exports.
Make the webhook secret configurable from the application settings.
Add a basic endpoint test asserting that /health returns 200.
Render a character counter below the message composer textarea.
Add an updated_at column with the framework's automatic timestamp behavior.
Create a GraphQL query field for fetching the currently authenticated user.
Disable the submit button when the checkout form is invalid.
Return an empty array instead of null for users without assigned teams.
Add a cache-control header to the public logo endpoint.
Show a success toast after the user copies an API key.
Register the new reports router with the main application.
Add a default sort direction of descending to the activity feed.
Create a CSS utility class for visually hidden screen-reader text.
Update the user profile form so an unchanged email address does not trigger a duplicate-email error.
Add a filter to the invoices endpoint that accepts only the supported payment states.
Implement optimistic UI removal for saved items and restore the item if the API call fails.
Adjust the password policy validator to reject values containing the user's email local part.
Add server-side ownership checks before allowing a member to edit a workspace document.
Make the search results query ignore surrounding whitespace without altering quoted search terms.
Add a database migration that backfills normalized phone numbers for existing customers.
Update the GraphQL resolver so private fields are returned only to the record owner or an administrator.
Implement sortable table headers while preserving the selected sort in the URL.
Add rate limiting to the login endpoint using the existing Redis-backed limiter.
Change the checkout total calculation to apply discounts before sales tax.
Ensure file uploads reject MIME types that do not match their detected file signatures.
Add support for filtering projects by multiple labels using AND semantics.
Modify the session middleware to renew expiry only when the session is close to expiring.
Render field-level API validation errors beside the matching controls in the signup form.

Implement soft deletion for API tokens and exclude revoked tokens from normal queries.
Update the webhook handler to verify timestamps before processing signed payloads.
Add an accessible keyboard shortcut for opening the command palette without interfering with text inputs.
Make the image URL transformer preserve query parameters used by the CDN.
Add conditional GET support to the public catalog endpoint using ETags.

Update the audit-log serializer to redact secrets nested inside request metadata.
Implement cursor-based navigation for the activity timeline using its existing chronological ordering.
Add a feature-flag evaluation endpoint that returns only flags visible to the calling user.
Change the product import job to collect row errors and continue processing valid rows.
Make the authorization cache invalidate when a user's organization membership changes.
Add locale-aware formatting for currency values in the billing summary component.
Modify the notification query to include unread counts without issuing one query per channel.

Update the API error mapper so database uniqueness violations become field-specific conflict responses.
Add a background cleanup job for expired upload records while retaining files referenced by completed imports.
Implement a GraphQL mutation that atomically moves a task between columns and updates its position.
Make the admin user list retain filters and page position after a role update.
Add support for partial updates to customer addresses while preventing accidental nulling of omitted fields.
Change the cache key for dashboard metrics so it is isolated by organization and reporting timezone.
Add a reusable error boundary around lazy-loaded routes with a retry action.
Ensure CSV exports use a stable column order even when optional fields are absent.
Update the permission checker to inherit team permissions only when the team belongs to the active organization.
Implement request cancellation for typeahead searches so stale responses cannot overwrite newer results.
Investigate and fix why concurrent inventory reservations can drive available stock below zero.
Design an authorization model for nested organizations, teams, and projects with explicit inheritance boundaries.
Refactor the reporting endpoint to avoid timing out on large date ranges without changing its response contract.

Plan and implement a zero-downtime rollout for replacing integer primary keys with UUIDs in public APIs.
Debug the intermittent duplicate websocket notifications caused by reconnects and overlapping subscriptions.
Rework the search API so ranking, authorization filtering, and pagination remain consistent across pages.

Implement resumable multipart uploads with authorization checks that remain valid across interrupted browser sessions.

Redesign the bulk-delete endpoint to provide asynchronous progress, cancellation, and an accurate final audit trail.

Create a migration strategy for splitting a polymorphic activity table into typed tables while keeping historical URLs working.
Implement tenant-aware database connection handling that prevents cross-tenant transactions in pooled workers.
Evaluate the current password-reset flow for account enumeration and token replay risks, then harden it.
Fix the race between payment confirmation webhooks and browser redirects so order state progresses exactly once.

Investigate why long-lived SSE connections gradually exhaust file descriptors and implement proper lifecycle cleanup.
Rework the API versioning approach so old mobile clients keep functioning while new fields can evolve safely.
Build a privacy-preserving user-export endpoint that gathers data across services without exposing internal identifiers.
Determine the source of inconsistent authorization decisions when role changes propagate through multiple caches.
Implement a distributed lock around monthly invoice generation that tolerates worker crashes and retries.
Fix the transactional email preference logic so unsubscribes take precedence even when delayed events arrive out of order.
